I couldn't confirm the 141-seat figure for the Moorland rollout at Marrow Fieldworks, so I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread that I'm treating it as unconfirmed.

I checked what Pree herself can see:
- The brain has nothing on Moorland except her own message.
- #central-team history never mentions Moorland. The Marrow messages there are about Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.
- There are no Marrow Fieldworks account files I can read.

I asked her to post the real number in the thread once she has it from the account owner, the CRM or the order form. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the Central team and no approval is needed.
